reasoning: The duplication is real and still present (sha2 0.10.9 at Cargo.lock:2033 and 0.11.1 at :2044), but the security framing is unsupported: conglobate's own integrity hashing is uniformly sha2 0.11 (`sha2 = "0.11"` in Cargo.toml, `use sha2::{Digest, Sha256}` in src/storage/sealed.rs), and gix-hash 0.25.1 also resolves to 0.11, so no in-house hash path is split across majors. The sole 0.10 consumers are devmap-verity 0.1.0 and pichi-artifact 0.1.0 — both first-party pichi-vm git dependencies, so unification is actually within the project's control rather than blocked upstream. Impact is binary size and a second digest stack to track, nothing more; deny.toml's `multiple-versions = "warn"` is the correct setting for that.
